 Horoscope: What rainy day activity should you partake in this week?
 Amused Aries 
 November 9, 2026 
 Vy Nguyen 
 Every rainy day brings a different kind of adventure. But have you ever wondered which rainy-day activity matches your personality? Let the forecast decide your fate.
 Aries (March 21 – April 19): Baking 
 Rainy weather is the perfect excuse to hole up in the kitchen. Try a new recipe, bake something you have been craving or make an unnecessarily large batch of cookies. Your roommate will thank you, and you will have something to snack on while the rain passes. 
 Taurus (April 20 – May 20): Watch the rain with a friend 
 The melancholic weather is calling for a little company. Find a friend, and spend some time watching the rain together. Not every hangout needs a plan. Some of the best conversations happen sitting in a loggia window and staring at the downpour. 
 Gemini (May 21 – June 21): Slip and slide 
 If you haven’t worn a trashbag covered in dish soap while plummeting down the side of a grassy hill, you haven’t lived. Your window for this activity is starting to close, so grab your best buds, a bottle of Dawn and find the steepest hill to make the most of this stormy weather.  
 Cancer (June 22 – July 22): Hot chocolate run  
 There’s no better excuse to get out of the house than a craving for hot chocolate on a rainy day. Treat yourself to a warm drink this week, not just because you deserve it, but to embrace the beginning of the cold season. 
 Leo (July 23 – August 22): Stand in the rain and embrace it   
 This week, the universe is asking you to stop worrying about looking a little ridiculous. Step outside, feel the rain and enjoy being completely present in the moment.  
 Virgo (August 23 – September 22): Dramatically confess your love 
 The outdoor conditions are practically BEGGING you to recreate every romance movie ever. Whether it’s a longtime crush, ex or a total stranger, tap into your dramatic side and share your feelings loud and proud.  
 Libra (September 23 – October 23): Write poetry  
 This weather makes it easy to get caught up in your feels. Whilst you succumb to seasonal depression, pick up a pen and paper and get it all out. 
 Scorpio (October 24 – November 21): Splash in puddles 
 Though this may sound rudimentary, your inner child yearns to stomp around on the sidewalk without a care. Whether you have rainboots or not, find the biggest puddle you can and give it a good jump — I guarantee big smiles.  
 Sagittarius (November 22 – December 21): Curl up in bed 
 Your adventurous side deserves a break, and the weather is giving you the perfect opportunity to slow down. Grab a blanket, put on some tunes and spend a few hours doing absolutely nothing. You can get back to your usual adventures when the sun comes out. 
 Capricorn (December 22 – January 19: Paper boat race 
 It’s time to put your competitive side to use in this torrential weather. Fold up a few paper boats, find a stream of rainwater and see whose boat makes it the farthest. You might be surprised by how invested you get in something so simple. 
 Aquarius (January 20 – February 18): Rewatch all of Twilight   
 It’s time to get your hoa hoa hoa on loca. The weather is making Grinnell, IA feel like Forks, Washington, and you have to embrace it by binging this iconic saga. Bonus points if you’re Team Edward.  
 Pisces (February 19 – March 20): Put your plants outside 
 Your plants are suffering post-break absence. Let them enjoy some natural rainfall sometime this week. They’ll be ever so grateful.
